errors.text_span: 最大的切片为“中国典籍与文化”
errors.evidence: The largest slice (67%) corresponds to “域外汉籍研究集刊” (Collection of Studies on Chinese Books Outside the Region), not “中国典籍与文化” (Chinese Classics and Culture), which only accounts for 2%.

errors.text_span: 紧随其后的是“中国传统文化研究”，占比7%
errors.evidence: The journal “中国传统文化研究” (Chinese Traditional Culture Research) does not exist in the chart's legend. The slice with 7% corresponds to “汉籍与汉学” (Chinese Books and Sinology).

errors.text_span: 其中“文献”、“图书馆论坛”、“文学遗产”、“国际汉学”、“图书馆理论与实践”、“古籍整理研究学刊”等各占3%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that all listed journals account for 3%. According to the chart, only “文献” (Documents/Literature) is 3%, while the other five journals listed (“图书馆论坛”, “文学遗产”, etc.) each account for 2%.

errors.text_span: “图书馆杂志”、“域外汉籍研究集刊”、“大学图书馆学报”、“新世纪图书馆”、“复旦学报(社会科学版)”、“清华大学学报(哲学社会科学版)”、“浙江大学学报(人文社会科学版)”、“图书馆建设”、“国外社会科学”、“文史哲”等各占2%
errors.evidence: This statement is grossly inaccurate. It claims all listed journals account for 2%. However, “图书馆杂志” (Library Journal) is 3% and “域外汉籍研究集刊” (Collection of Studies on Chinese Books Outside the Region) is 67%.

errors.text_span: 颜色分别为橙色、深红色、紫色、深蓝色、深蓝色和棕色
errors.evidence: The colors listed do not correctly correspond to the journals mentioned in that part of the sentence. For example, “文献” (Documents/Literature) is blue, not orange.

errors.text_span: 颜色分别为浅橙色、深绿色、紫色、浅绿色、浅蓝色、浅粉色、浅橙色、浅紫色、深青色和深绿色
errors.evidence: The colors listed do not correctly correspond to the journals mentioned in that part of the sentence. For example, “域外汉籍研究集刊” (the 67% slice) is teal/青绿色, not deep green (深绿色).
The legend is located on both the left and right sides of the pie chart, not just on the right side.
